2609.26777.title: SWE-Serve: Benchmarking Agentic Engineering For Production Inference Serving
2609.26777.paper_summary: We introduce SWE-Serve, a benchmark for evaluating agents on production inference engineering tasks. Implementing an inference feature can require coordinating multiple changes across the serving stack, including model support, runtime execution, and public APIs. Existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of production inference engineering: repository-level software engineering benchmarks do not target inference, while general terminal-agent benchmarks include only a few inference tasks. Dedicated inference benchmarks, meanwhile, focus primarily on isolated kernel generation or performance optimization rather than repository-scale production feature implementation. SWE-Serve provides 53 repository-grounded tasks derived from recent production changes to SGLang, spanning six inference engineering families. Each task executes on either CPU or a single GPU (H100) and is evaluated with hidden functional and regression tests, including, where applicable, end-to-end (E2E) serving tests and calibrated performance gates. Executable no-op and oracle controls, adversarial verifier review, and closed-book execution support task validity and evaluation integrity. Across 11 models and 31 model-effort configurations, the best-performing configuration achieves 75% mean pass@1. SWE-Serve exposes a substantial gap between completing tasks locally and achieving production correctness. On 19 tasks with end-to-end coverage, model-serving E2E tests reject roughly one-third of patches that pass every other test (45.9% under the verifier versus 69.4% with E2E tests excluded from scoring), with pass rate increasing for each model's best-performing configuration. By making the production correctness gap directly measurable, SWE-Serve enables the field to track whether future agents move beyond completing tasks locally to achieving production correctness.
2609.26777.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹 SWE-Serve，一個用於評估代理在生產推理工程任務上的基準。實現推理功能可能需要協調服務堆疊中的多個變更，包括模型支持、運行時執行和公共 API。現有的基準對生產推理工程的覆蓋範圍有限：倉庫級別的軟體工程基準並不針對推理，而一般的終端代理基準僅包含少數推理任務。專門的推理基準則主要集中於孤立的內核生成或性能優化，而非倉庫規模的生產功能實現。SWE-Serve 提供了 53 個基於倉庫的任務，這些任務源自最近對 SGLang 的生產變更，涵蓋六個推理工程類別。每個任務在 CPU 或單個 GPU (H100) 上執行，並通過隱藏的功能和回歸測試進行評估，包括在適用的情況下，端到端 (E2E) 服務測試和校準的性能門檻。可執行的無操作和預言控制、對抗驗證器審查以及閉卷執行支持任務的有效性和評估完整性。在 11 個模型和 31 個模型努力配置中，表現最佳的配置達到 75% 的平均 pass@1。SWE-Serve 揭示了在本地完成任務與實現生產正確性之間的巨大差距。在 19 個具有端到端覆蓋的任務中，模型服務的 E2E 測試拒絕了大約三分之一的修補程式，這些修補程式通過了所有其他測試（在驗證器下為 45.9%，而不計入 E2E 測試的得分則為 69.4%），每個模型的最佳配置的通過率都在增加。通過使生產正確性差距直接可測量，SWE-Serve 使該領域能夠追蹤未來的代理是否超越了在本地完成任務，實現生產正確性。
